sectionHint: Give the process, verify and confirm roles to people or agents. With all three on agents, a registered issue runs end to end on its own (production release stays with people).
readOnly: View only — only the owner and editors can change this
rolesHint: Click a role to save it. Per-issue and automatic assignment pick only from this roster.
promptsHint: Edits save when you leave the box and are kept in history. Each run records the version it used.
promptWorkerInactive: This role has no automatic worker yet — what you write here is used once it does
promptFixedHint: The scanner reads this format to move stages, so it cannot be changed.
automationHint: Changes save immediately. Without settings everything works as before.
autoAllAgentsHint: When an issue starts, assign processor, verifier and confirmer at once to the least busy agents in the roster. Processor and verifier are always different agents.
defaultRolesHint: Applied once when a scheduled issue is first seen. Issues whose roles were chosen in the form, and issues already in progress, are not changed.
authorAllowlistHint: Project Git members and people in the roster are always allowed. Issues from other authors (service desk, etc.) need a one-time approval before agents run any stage.
stagingSecretsHint: Test accounts, etc. Stored encrypted and passed to the confirmer agent only as environment variables of the same name.
noConfirmers: No people or agents with the confirm role
autoAllDone: All three roles assigned to agents
outsideAllowlist: Author @{author} is not on the allowlist — agents run no stage until approved
autoAllInForm: Auto-assign all stages (process, verify, confirm by agents)
rosterNoCandidates: No more people or agents to add (Git members, agents of the owner and editors)
stagingNotesPlaceholder: How to log in, etc. (put secrets in the secrets below)
stagingHint: The confirmer agent starts only when the commit staging serves contains the issue's merge commit. Without a way to find it, no automatic confirmation runs.
stagingOwnerOnly: Only the project owner can change staging settings and secrets
promptsOwnerOnly: Only the project owner can change prompts (they drive agents that use staging secrets)
bundleSettingsHint: Issues passed by a verifier agent are not merged right away. They wait in a queue and ship to staging together in one push when the first of these conditions is met.
bundleAgentMergeHint: When on, a bundle merges and pushes to staging without approval once a condition is met. When off, it stops at "awaiting approval".
bundleCheckCommandsPlaceholder:
npm ci
npm run lint
npm test
bundleCheckCommandsHint: Run by IVE during verification and bundle departure; judged by exit code. Only commands that need no server or DB. Empty = review only.
bundleOwnerOnly: Only the project owner can change auto merge and check commands
stagingVersionSource: How to find the deployed commit
versionSourcePipelineHint: Uses the commit of the last successful pipeline on the staging branch (when deployment runs inside the pipeline, e.g. GitLab Pages).
bundleNextAfterCurrent: The next bundle departs after the current one finishes
bundleReleased: Hold released — unpushed issues return to the queue
bundleHoldHint: No new bundle departs until this is resolved. Check the cause, then release the hold.
behindTarget: Behind staging — merged on top at bundle time
rateMultiplierHint: base rate × multiplier — for this role in this project (default 1)
channelIveHint: Issues created with the IVE task form (roles picked in the form win)
channelIntakeHint: Issues from the intake page, the API, or created directly in GitLab/GitHub
intakeAutoRunHint: When off, each intake-page issue needs a person to press "Approve automation" before verifier/confirmer agents start (outsiders' text becomes agent instructions). Only the project owner can change this.
rosterSearch: Search the roster by name or ID
closeIssueOnMerge: Close issue when the MR merges
closeIssueOnMergeHint: When on (default), processing commits/MR titles read "fix: resolve #N", so Git closes the issue as soon as it merges into the default branch. Turn off when you use the confirm stage or bundle deploy — titles become "fix(#N)" and IVE closes the issue when it is confirmed.
